title: LS_AIS Structure Atlas
description: LS_AIS conformational ensemble atlases. Starting with PDCD2 (full 11,000-model cohort); legacy LS_AIS targets (HSPH1, DOC1-CDK2, DOC1R-CDK2, CDK2-DOC1 monomers, CIT) will migrate into this registry.
